title: Failed-attempt cause evidence in the review run artifact
summary: Failed reviewer attempts now carry a `cause` — a fixed-vocabulary `basis` naming what the classifier matched, plus a tail of the last 40 lines of the harness output — into the `--out` run artifact only. `failure::diagnose` returns the basis alongside the category, `failure::cause` builds the tail, and `reviewers` threads it out of `run_child` through `Failure::Exited`/`TimedOut` into `AttemptCause`. `review_run::scrub_run` redacts the tail with the job's secrets and caps line length before the file is written; the journal, summary, step log and posted review never see it.

nodes.label: Reviewer CLI
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / …
nodes.summary: The agent binary osf spawns per attempt. Its stdout and stderr are the only evidence of why an attempt failed.

nodes.label: run_child
nodes.subtitle: spawn, capture, classify
nodes.summary: Captures stdout and stderr, and on a non-zero exit or a timeout now builds a `failure::Cause` from both streams and attaches it to the `Failure` variant instead of discarding the text.

nodes.label: failure
nodes.subtitle: classify / diagnose / cause
nodes.summary: `classify` is now a thin wrapper over `diagnose`, which returns the category plus a fixed-vocabulary basis string. `cause` builds the tail, `cap_line_lengths` cuts long lines, and `TAIL_LINES`/`TAIL_LINE_CHARS` are the limits.

nodes.label: run_one_noted
nodes.subtitle: (Outcome, notes, cause)
nodes.summary: Signature grows a third return value: the cause of the last failed harness run, if any. `run_with_retry` threads a `&mut Option<Cause>` down to each `Failure::into_outcome`.

nodes.label: Attempts::next
nodes.subtitle: builds Attempt
nodes.summary: Consumes the cause from `run_one_noted` and stores it on the `Attempt` as an `AttemptCause`.

nodes.label: AttemptCause
nodes.subtitle: basis + tail
nodes.summary: New serialized struct on `Attempt`: `basis` (fixed vocabulary, never provider text) and `tail` (raw reviewer text until scrubbed). Skipped when absent, so old run files still parse.

nodes.label: scrub_run
nodes.subtitle: redact then cap
nodes.summary: Redacts the tail whole with the job's secrets (plain, base64, hex) and pattern rules, then applies `cap_line_lengths`, so a cut can never split a secret.

nodes.label: Run artifact (--out)
nodes.subtitle: review-run-<agent>
nodes.summary: The JSON file CI uploads. The only place the scrubbed tail and basis are written; a reader downloads it to see the evidence.

nodes.label: Journal
nodes.summary: Records the category and reason only. The tail never reaches it.

nodes.label: Console / SARIF / posted review
nodes.summary: Every other sink keeps the category-only behaviour; the step log never prints the tail.

nodes.label: review_run integration tests
nodes.subtitle: cause kept, secret removed, 40-line cap
nodes.summary: New tests assert the tail survives into the saved file, that a secret in the output never reaches it, and that the tail is capped at 40 lines with the held key removed in all three encodings.
